Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly by following the example there.

Syntax to use in all statement sections:
[[ ]] for variables (S)
{{ }} for constants (0, 1, 111, #)
<< >> for bold (Line 1)

Goal
* Please remove the final line ("Input:").

Constraints
* Please change 100 to 10 as no input strings are longer than 10 characters.

Stub generator
* Please change 100 to 10.

* Please change "hello Guys" to "answer".

Cases
* Please revise the cases so that each test and its corresponding validator cover the same scenario using slightly different inputs and outputs.

Thanks.
